ValidationRule.description: Sub status field should not be actioned when status is actioned
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Coach_Nudge', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Callback_Request') , ISCHANGED(Status) , ISPICKVAL(Status,'Actioned') , ISBLANK(TEXT( Sub_Status__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sub Status cannot be left blank if status is Actioned.
